title: 第15章 这神印可能会有点痛第16章 夜半来客
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
“卧槽，我可没疯！第三境打第五境？你开什么玩笑？”君傲在心底疯狂咆哮。
“小子，富贵险中求的道理，你应该懂。”
“这他妈不是‘险’，这是纯纯找死！”
万魂幡沉默片刻，似乎也在权衡。
半晌，那沙哑的声音再次响起：
“这样……本尊有一门禁术，名为‘神印’。此印一出，可短暂禁锢高你三个大境界内的敌人神魂。本尊将这神印传授与你，如何？”
君傲心头一动：“你竟然有这种好东西！”
“不过，往你神魂中种下这神印，可能会有些许疼痛！”
“你嘴里的‘些许’，怕是能疼死人吧？”
经过这几天的相处，君傲太了解这老东西了……
它说“有点”，那绝对是撕心裂肺。
“你两世为人，神魂比常人强大数倍，应当可以承受。”
君傲咬了咬牙。
“行，我试试。不过丑话说在前头，我要是承受不住，这神印我就不要了。”
“成交。”
话音刚落——
君傲气海内，万魂幡骤然红光暴涨！
一股难以形容的剧痛，如同千万根烧红的钢针，狠狠刺入他的神魂深处！
“啊——！！！”
君傲差点惨叫出声，牙齿咬得咯咯作响，额头上青筋暴起，冷汗瞬间浸透后背。

他双腿一软，险些跪倒在地，全靠剑撑住身体。
这叫“有点痛”？！
这他妈简直是十八层地狱走一遭！
“公子！”阿水脸色大变，以为他旧伤爆发，上前就要搀扶。
君傲抬手制止，从牙缝里挤出两个字：“别……动……”
他整个人剧烈颤抖，眼前阵阵发黑。
那股痛楚持续了约莫十息，才如潮水般退去。
痛楚消失的瞬间，君傲感觉自己的神魂深处，多了一道极其复杂、泛着暗金色流光的印记。
“这便是‘神印’。”万魂幡的声音听起来虚弱了几分，显然消耗不小，“对敌时心念一动，便可发动。以你目前的神魂强度……大概能禁锢第五境一息时间。”
一息。
生死之间，够用了。
剧痛褪去，君傲缓缓直起身，脸上竟浮现出一丝诡异的笑容。
院中众人都看懵了！
方才还痛苦得几乎昏厥，转眼又笑得像个疯子？
然后，在所有人困惑的目光中，君傲抬起剑，指向一直缩在角落的赵虎，或者说，井下。
content_en:
"Damn it, I'm not crazy! The third level is fighting the fifth level? Are you kidding me?" Jun Ao roared crazily in his heart.
"Boy, you should understand the principle of finding wealth in danger."
"This is not a 'danger', this is pure courting death!"
Wanhun Banner was silent for a moment, seeming to be weighing the situation as well.
After a while, the hoarse voice sounded again:
"In this way... I have a forbidden technique called 'Divine Seal'. Once this seal is released, it can temporarily imprison the souls of enemies three realms above you. How about I teach this divine seal to you?"
Jun Ao's heart moved: "You actually have such a good thing!"
"However, planting this divine seal into your soul may cause some pain!"
"The 'little' in your mouth might hurt someone to death, right?"
After getting along with each other these days, Jun Ao knows this old thing too well...
It says "kind of" and that's absolutely heartbreaking.
"You have been a human for two lifetimes, and your soul is several times stronger than an ordinary person's. You should be able to withstand it."
Jun Ao gritted his teeth.
"Okay, I'll give it a try. But the ugly words are ahead. If I can't bear it, I won't want this divine seal."
"Deal."
As soon as the words fell——
In the midst of Jun's arrogance, the Ten Thousand Souls Flag suddenly burst into red light!
An indescribable pain, like thousands of red-hot steel needles, pierced deep into his soul!
"Ah——!!!"
Jun Ao almost screamed, his teeth clenched, veins popped out on his forehead, and cold sweat instantly soaked his back.
His legs weakened and he almost fell to his knees, relying on his sword to support his body.
Is this "a little painful"? !
This is simply a trip to the 18th level of hell!
"Master!" Ah Shui's expression changed drastically. He thought that his old injury had broken out, so he stepped forward to help him.
Jun Ao raised his hand to stop him and squeezed out two words from between his teeth: "Don't... move..."
His whole body was shaking violently, and his eyesight turned black.
The pain lasted for about ten breaths before receding like a tide.
The moment the pain disappeared, Jun Ao felt that there was an extremely complex mark glowing with dark golden light deep in his soul.
"This is the 'Divine Seal'." The voice of the Ten Thousand Soul Banner sounded a bit weak, and it was obviously very expensive. "When facing the enemy, it can be activated with a thought. With your current soul strength... it can probably imprison the fifth realm for one breath."
One breath.
Between life and death, it is enough.
After the severe pain subsided, Jun Ao slowly straightened up, with a strange smile appearing on his face.
Everyone in the courtyard was stunned!
He was almost fainting from pain just now, and now he is laughing like a madman?
Then, under everyone's confused gazes, Jun Ao raised his sword and pointed it at Zhao Hu, who had been huddled in the corner, or in other words, down the well.
